title: PBRgen update, seamless PBR materials in browser
author: Super_Golf_1404
selftext:
Hi aigamedev, we got some nice reactions here last time we posted a couple months ago. But to be honest, we noticed the tool was not fully living up to what people expected.



So over the past months we went back and rebuilt a large part of it. This update is our attempt to fix that and make it something that is useful in real workflows.



jump in the tool here: [https://pbrgen.aixpoly.com/?utm\_source=rdt\_aigd\_01](https://pbrgen.aixpoly.com/?utm_source=rdt_aigd_01)



The prompt adherence and input colors work a lot better, and the tool now comes with a lot of presets. You can upload displacement maps to steer your generation, with presets that are handy if you are making things like bricks or tiles and want a specific scale and layout. PBR maps have also improved and hold up better under lighting. The workflow has changed so you first generate a set of previews and then pick the one you like most before creating a full material. It is also possible to upload your own photos, and the tool does a pretty good job of removing perspective. All materials are tileable and export with one click.



There is also a short YouTube video that shows how the tool works in about a minute if you want a quick overview. (youtube.com/watch?v=bWdbY6MqiHs)



It is free to try and I would love to hear some feedback. If you want some extra credits to test things, let me know in the comments.



I'm also happy to create a material for you and share how it looks here.



Appreciate any thoughts, especially what still does not feel production ready.



Flip
